role 限 user / assistant / system / tool；: role is limited to user / assistant / system / tool; tags are optional, for marking sources like "this entry is an injected fact". When it includes a tool call, **write the whole turn at once** (the assistant message that makes the call plus each tool's return) — writing only half leaves a truncated sequence on the next read, which errors out immediately when fed back to the model
删掉带某标签的消息（如 run:<运行id>——作废一轮运行写入的记忆）: Delete messages carrying a given tag (e.g. run:<run id> — to invalidate the memory written by one run)
删掉某个会话的全部消息: Delete all messages in a session
只列这个时间之后有活动的（RFC3339）: Only list sessions active after this time (RFC3339)
只要带其中任一标签的消息；留空=不过滤: Only messages carrying any of these tags; leave blank to skip filtering
可选：只删该会话内的: Optional: only delete within this session
同一个记忆里的哪一段对话，通常绑上游变量（如聊天 id）: Which conversation within the same memory — usually bound to an upstream variable (e.g. a chat id)
外部链接；与 file_id 二选一: External link; use either this or file_id
多轮对话拼成的纯文本，可直接内联进提示词: Plain text assembled from the multi-turn conversation, ready to inline into a prompt
带此标签的消息全部删除: Delete all messages carrying this tag
平台文件 id（受文件回收保护）: Platform file id (protected from file cleanup)
按会话键读出最近若干条对话: Read the most recent messages for a session key
按最近活动倒序: Sorted by most recent activity, descending
调用 id，工具返回靠它对上: Call id, used to match up the tool's return
调用参数的 JSON 原文（不解析再序列化：模型偶尔吐坏 JSON，那正是排查时: Raw JSON text of the call arguments (not parsed and re-serialized — the model occasionally emits malformed JSON, and that's exactly what you need to see when debugging)
这个记忆里有哪些会话、各自多少条、最近何时活动: Which sessions exist in this memory, how many entries each has, and when each was last active
这次要读多少条；留空用记忆资源上配的窗口: How many entries to read this time; leave blank to use the window configured on the memory resource
